title: Paloma and the Songbook
author: Isandro Thackeray
blurb: Vesper Vane, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
